[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the differences between MacPherson Strut and Double Wishbone suspension systems, including their pros and cons.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that MacPherson Strut systems are simple and compact but may have limited travel and less precise handling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described Double Wishbone systems as allowing for more precise control of the wheel's motion.
